caveats: The Q4 value is derived, not reported directly. It is the fiscal-year total (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30) minus the nine-month year-to-date total (2025-07-01 to 2026-03-31).

claims.text: PG's capital expenditures (payments to acquire property, plant and equipment) for fiscal Q4 2026 (April 1 to June 30, 2026) were about $1.023 billion. The figure is derived as full-year FY2026 capex of $4.409 billion minus nine-month capex of $3.386 billion.

raw_output.summary: Procter & Gamble's capital expenditures in fiscal Q4 2026 (April 1 to June 30, 2026) were about $1.023 billion. This figure is derived from full-year and nine-month cash flow figures.
